title: lycopodiella tomentosa
intro: Lycopodiella tomentosa, commonly known as the woolly clubmoss, is a small, perennial plant belonging to the family Lycopodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodiella tomentosa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
